title: EV Trip Cost per Mile Outlier
app: FlightAware, OpenSky, MarineTraffic, ADS-B receivers, ABRP trip plans, toll-tag exports, and EV charging receipts forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=abrp:trip
| eval cost_per_mile=round(total_trip_cost_usd/trip_miles,2)
| where trip_miles>20
| eventstats avg(cost_per_mile) as baseline_cost_per_mile by vehicle
| where cost_per_mile>baseline_cost_per_mile*1.3
| sort - cost_per_mile
description: Uses ABRP trip summaries telemetry to monitor which trips cost far more per mile than normal in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for route choices or charging prices that spiked trip cost, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest ABRP trip summaries data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Trip table of cost per mile versus baseline.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights which trips cost far more per mile than normal so you can spot route choices or charging prices that spiked trip cost before it becomes annoying.
